notes: All geometry is authored as integer block coordinates. No generated picture substitutes for the model.
The existing house blueprint is unchanged.
Glass represents still water; the flower sculptures and trellises do not animate.
This scene uses only vanilla block IDs in the original editor palette.
Main promenade floor Y=5; external entrance floor Y=1; raised bridge summit floor Y=8.
Four adjoining 48-cell-or-smaller NBT tiles are required for export.
